rules.statement: The remedy for a possessory action is available even when the defendant entered into possession after the plaintiff was dispossessed by third parties, provided that the defendant's act continues the unlawful transaction.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think the correct way of looking at the dispute is to regard the ouster of the plaintiff in September and November as only a part of an unlawful transaction which continued till November, and the defendant's entry as another part of the same transaction."
